#### Reports Tab

The Reports tab contains meter-level report options that are associated with and affect the behavior of several standard reports. In addition, Contract Hour, Contract Day, and Data Span are displayed as read-only fields from the meter’s most recent characteristic record.

This tab also includes the option to enable a meter for TESTit Integrated.

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available on the Reports tab:

- **Contract Hour** - Displays as read-only field using the meter’s most recent characteristic record.

- **Contract Day** - Displays as read-only field using the meter’s most recent characteristic record.

- **Time Leads Data/Time Trails Data** - Displays as read-only field using the meter’s most recent characteristic record.

- **Read Tolerance** - Read tolerances (in days) may be set for monthly records. Records whose actual (entered) on date is within the read tolerance will be snapped to contract start of month. Records whose actual (entered) off date is within the read tolerance will be snapped to the contract end of month.

- **Print Customer Name** - If set to "Yes", the customer name (selected on the [General tab](General%20Tab.md)) will replace the company name or logo defined in FLOWCAL on meter-level reports.

- **Print Edit Reasons on Gas Volume Statement** - By default, Daily and Hourly Gas Volume Statements identify each record as edited or not, but do not print the edit reasons. With this option, you can choose to:
  - Show Codes and Reasons
  - Indicate Edited Data, No Reasons
  - No Edit Indicators

- **Print Interval or Fixed Factor on Gas Volume Statement** - Determines whether the interval or fixed factor will be displayed on the Gas Volume Statement. For charts, "interval" refers to the rotation. For EFMs, "fixed factor" refers to the data resolution defined in the meter’s characteristics.

- **Print Alternate Meter Number Instead of Meter Name** - On many meter reports, the alternate meter number specified on the [General](General%20Tab.md) tab can be displayed instead of the meter name.

- **Print Volume at Optional Pressure Base** - If set to "Yes", the volume will be recalculated at the pressure base specified in the **Use Pressure Base of** field. This recalculated volume will then be printed at the bottom of the Daily Gas Volume Statement, along with the optional pressure base. The value entered for the optional pressure base must be between 9.000 and 20.000 psi.

- **Use Pressure Base of** - Used in conjunction with the Print Volume at Optional Pressure Base option.

- **Print Measurement Area** - If set to "Yes", the measurement area will be printed at the top of most meter reports that display one meter per page.

- **Measurement Area** - Select a measurement area from the drop-down or, with the correct privileges, click the **New** button to create a new Measurement Area. Measurement areas are managed from the [Measurement Area Editor](../../Settings%20Manager/Geographic/Measurement%20Area%20Editor.md).

- **Chart Change Schedule** - Chart labels can be created for scheduled chart routes. An annual schedule is used to specify the on and off dates for the charts, which is used when printing the Bar Code Labels report. (See: [Annual Schedule Editor](../../Settings%20Manager/Application/Annual%20Schedule%20Editor.md))

- **Show Off Spec on Batch Ticket** - If set to "Yes", [exceptions 30009 - 30040](../../Exceptions/Exception%20Directory/30000/30000-30999.md) on the batch data generated based on product specifications will display on the Meter Batch Ticket reports (liquid meters only).

- **Enabled for TESTit** - This field is set to "No" by default when a meter is created. With TESTit Integrated, you can set this field to "Yes" to enable the meter for TESTit.

  This feature requires TESTit Integrated.

  - **For TESTit 2 Integrated** - Once this field is set to "Yes", it cannot be changed due to the audit trail and the ability to link TESTit tasks to the meter.
  - **For TESTit 3 Integrated** - This field may be set back to "No". The tasks in TESTit 3 are not affected by this change.

- **Test Reports** - Click this button to access the TESTit test reports for the meter. This is only available if the meter is TESTit enabled.

- **Skip Closing Data** - When set to "Yes", closing the meter will be prohibited.
